classifiedFinding.title: dispatcherHook.mintDebt() is trusted-input to V, budget, and windowEnd; a malicious or buggy hook can inflate emissions and DoS claims

classification.assetImpact: Reward-claim DoS (similar end-state to C-01) when the dispatcher hook returns a mintDebt() value that pull() does not actually deliver. _updatePool advances accRewardPerShare against an inflated rewardBudget; eventually _safePay reverts on shortfall. Recoverable via owner topUp; principal recoverable via emergencyWithdraw with reward forfeit.
attackPath: 1. Owner installs a hook returning huge mintDebt() but pull() yields much less (compromise, bug, or careless deployment).
2. Stakers interact; _syncBudget invokes pull() (small or zero balance delta); _recomputeSchedule reads V = balance + huge mintDebt and extends windowEnd.
3. _updatePool moves emissions into committedDebt at the inflated rewardRate.
4. A claim attempts _safePay; balance < pending; reverts with 'insufficient reward balance'.
5. Recovery: owner topUp, replace hook, or users take emergencyWithdraw and forfeit rewards.
classification.likelihood: n/a - centralization risk; depends on owner installing a faulty or hostile hook.
classification.assumptions: Hook returns mintDebt() it cannot deliver via pull(). Same trust domain as the owner.
classification.externalRequirements: Owner action installing a hook that misbehaves; no external attacker path.

classifiedFinding.justification: Centralization. Fundamentally a trust assumption on the owner-set dispatcher hook. The finding text itself states 'Primarily a centralization risk — but a buggy (not malicious) hook in the same trust domain triggers the same outcome.' Per C4 universal-known-invalid: 'Privileged address attacks (unless contract intended no privilege)' are out of scope at the High/Medium tier. The contract intentionally trusts the hook, so this is a defensive-depth observation about how lax that trust is. Surfaced as Centralization rather than Low because the failure mode is more severe than a typical input-validation footgun (full reward-claim DoS plus runway distortion).
